map.位置与动量不确定度的乘积下限。: Lower bound on the product of position and momentum uncertainties.
map.海森堡不确定性原理：Δx × Δp 不低于 ħ ÷ 2，其中约化普朗克常数 ħ: Heisenberg uncertainty principle: Delta x x Delta p is no lower than hbar / 2, where the reduced Planck constant hbar = h / 2pi = 1.0546 x 10^-34 J s; the equivalent form is Delta E x Delta t no lower than hbar / 2 (energy and time); for an electron, if the position uncertainty is 1 x 10^-10 m, the momentum uncertainty is no lower than 5.27 x 10^-25 kg m/s and the velocity uncertainty about 5.8 x 10^5 m/s; the smaller the uncertainty of one quantity, the larger the lower bound of the other, forming a measurement limit.
map.陷阱粒子动量展宽。: Momentum broadening of a trapped particle.
map.Δp 增大 100 倍=5.27e-23，位置越准动量越不确定。: Delta p increases 100x = 5.27e-23; the more precisely position is known, the more uncertain momentum is.
map.能同时精确测吗？: Can both be measured precisely at the same time?
map.不能；Δx·Δp≥ħ/2 是内禀极限，非仪器精度问题。: No; Delta x Delta p >= hbar/2 is an intrinsic limit, not an instrument-precision issue.
map.同为不确定关系，但变量不同（位置-动量 vs 能量-时间）。: Both are uncertainty relations but with different variables (position-momentum vs energy-time).
